# pdf-lib 1.17.1

Unmodified UMD distribution from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/pdf-lib/-/pdf-lib-1.17.1.tgz (`package/dist/pdf-lib.min.js`).
MIT license: `LICENSE.md`, from https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib/tree/v1.17.1.
API: https://pdf-lib.js.org/docs/api/classes/pdfdocument#copypages.

Only `assets/pdf-merge-worker.js` imports this file, and only for custom exports
of 2–15 courses. There are no CDN or other external runtime requests.
